REVISED 2026-09-29: an earlier version of this entry claimed the truncation had a specific SPEI-bias direction (relative to the untreated negative PET value); withdrawn -- a negative Hargreaves PET is a formula artifact below T_mean < -17.8 degC, never a physically valid quantity, so there is no meaningful 'untreated' baseline to be biased relative to, and truncating to zero is a correction, not a bias-introducing treatment. The real limitation (L16, docs/LIMITATIONS.md, rewritten) is that Hargreaves-Samani/the water-balance-SPEI framework has no snow accumulation/melt process and so cannot represent a glacial-regime catchment's water balance at all, independent of the truncation choice; affects the same 51 cells / 144 India hydro plants (37% of the country's hydro fleet).
